notes: Mel and Joyce Williams' Angus ranch just north of Lawrence. Read the homepage, our practices, health benefits, contact and pricing page, and the two linked PDFs (bulk order sheet updated 01JAN26 and cut price list updated 01MAY26) (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). Our practices: cattle rotated on pasture, own brome, alfalfa and clover hay in winter; no grain mentioned. Bulk: quarter (front or hind), half or whole at a price per lb hanging weight, $100 deposit, requests by email in January, spring and fall hauling; buyer picks up and pays processing at Steve's Meat Market (DeSoto) or Baumans Butcher Block (Ottawa). Cut price list: ground beef currently sold out, liver, heart, soup bones and tallow balm listed; order by phone or email (mjranch66044@gmail.com).
